title: Zesty Smoky British Mixed Berries Crumble
description: A romantic British dessert featuring frozen mixed berries, with a smoky and zesty twist, made in an iron teppan, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium heat, ensuring it reaches a safe temperature of 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the thawed mixed berries, coconut sugar, smoked paprika, lemon zest, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, coconut oil, and large eggs until well combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the berry mixture and stir until a crumbly mixture forms.
Pour the crumbly mixture into the preheated iron teppan and spread it out evenly.
Cook the crumble for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove the teppan from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Zesty Smoky British Mixed Berries Crumble warm, garnished with fresh berries if desired.
